auditor_value: a-t graph: constant −10 m/s² from t = 0 to t = 8 s. v-t graph: straight line from +40 m/s at t = 0 to −40 m/s at t = 8 s, crossing zero at t = 4 s. s-t graph: inverted parabola from 0 m, peak 80 m at t = 4 s, back to 0 m at t = 8 s.

findings.note: The printed formula is false. The maximum height of a body thrown up with speed u is u²/2g, not u²/4g; u²/4g gives 1600/40 = 40 m, half the stated 80 m. The substitution that follows actually divides by 2g = 20, so the line contradicts itself, and a student who copies the symbolic form loses the mark.

notes: Every other line, the final answer and both common_mistakes entries are correct; only the symbolic denominator in this one line is wrong.
